name: ndp
description: Work with the National Data Platform (NDP) through CLIO's own NDP source: find organizations, datasets and resources (filtered by resource format, with each resource's own description), find data for a place and topic across organizations with coverage checked from each record or its own service, select the tiles of a multi-tile dataset that cover a region, attach and download the selected resources as workspace sources, query NDP Endpoints and publish results.
